scripts.preinstall: sh -c 'rm -f package-lock.json yarn.lock; if [ -z "$npm_config_user_agent" ] || echo "$npm_config_user_agent" | grep -q "^pnpm/"; then true; else echo "Use pnpm instead" >&2; exit 1; fi'
scripts.build: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm -r --if-present run build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run typecheck:libs && pnpm -r --filter "./artifacts/**" --filter "./scripts" --if-present run typecheck
